control_coordinates: x_1,...,x_n: independent fair physical bits, allowed in every state update and every phase increment
data_coordinates: One independent fair sign y_z for each a-bit state z; the same y_z is shared by all paths and all stages reaching that state
selector_freshness: Not assumed across levels. The whole x block is independent of the y block.
branch_dependence: Branches may share all controls and all terminal data. Baseline disjoint or fresh composition identities are not multiplied through the program.
state_update: M_0=0; M_t=A_t M_(t-1)+B_t over F2; fixed arbitrary a-by-a A_t and a-by-n B_t
phase_update: q_0=0; q_t=q_(t-1)+p_t over F2; each p_t has degree at most two
exact_required_statistics: b_t=number zero M_t columns with nonzero polar row
d_t=number zero M_t columns with zero polar row and linear coefficient one
collision_certificate: For each reachable z, signed indicator of M_t x=z has 2^(r_t+k_t) nonzero control coefficients, all squared magnitude 2^(-2r_t-k_t). Different terminal labels have different data singleton frequencies. Coherent history collisions are resolved in the signed indicator before squaring.
label_sharing: Pay terminal state label r_t bits once per whole Fourier set. Pay r_t+k_t conditional control-frequency bits separately. Do not pay independent labels at each level or coordinate.
guard: Arbitrary nonquadratic phases or identification of distinct y_z bits are outside the proved ledger; both can introduce unpaid Fourier entropy/cross-label collisions.
proof: RECURSIVE_ADDRESSING.tex, Rank and fiber-phase ledger theorem
